release_gate: Issuer-listed RFQ is represented with one unambiguous source and response deadline
execution_source: Original buyer PDF and authorized staging workflow
pass_condition: Recorded solicitation number and public closing timestamp match authoritative signed source
evidence_required: Original PDF checksum and stage page capture

release_gate: Eligible staged supplier can register and receive only authorized document views
execution_source: Approved staging accounts and role matrix
pass_condition: Supplier completes authorized signup; another role cannot access private supplier data
evidence_required: Source-verified role test and vendor notification trace

release_gate: Addendum versions and vendor delivery events trace to source
execution_source: Approved staging solicitation with issuer-generated addendum
pass_condition: Every staged addendum has version history timestamps and recipient notice evidence
evidence_required: Issuer staged revision and notification log export

release_gate: No late submissions; offer remains hidden until permitted opening
execution_source: Official RFQ cutoff converted to zone-aware timestamp and authorized staging clock
pass_condition: Submission before threshold accepted; after threshold rejected; pre-opening bids inaccessible
evidence_required: Clock zone data plus two original portal responses and role audit

release_gate: Review and scoring preserve actor identity and authorized transitions
execution_source: Permitted staging evaluator roles and rubric
pass_condition: Unauthorized actor cannot score; authorized score changes carry actor and timestamp
evidence_required: Evaluation event export and role denial capture

release_gate: Final operator can reproduce solicitation/addenda/award record
execution_source: Approved stage tenant with permitted audit export
pass_condition: Source IDs and metadata survive export and meet agreed accessibility/export format
evidence_required: Bid event export checksum and accessibility review with owner signoff

execution_source: Approved staging error-injection with seller vendor engineer
pass_condition: Idempotent retest and clear failure reason preserve original solicitation state
evidence_required: Staged request IDs trace log and vendor defect ownership
